title: Crab dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- legs -->
  <g stroke='#ff7b5e' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'>
    <path d='M36 68 L22 78'/>
    <path d='M38 74 L28 86'/>
    <path d='M64 68 L78 78'/>
    <path d='M62 74 L72 86'/>
    <path d='M30 60 L14 60'/>
    <path d='M70 60 L86 60'/>
  </g>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='24' ry='16' fill='#ff5c39'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='24' ry='16' fill='none' stroke='#ffa07a' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- shell highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='51' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#ff9d7b'/>
  <!-- eyes on stalks -->
  <g stroke='#ff8a66' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <line x1='43' y1='44' x2='41' y2='34'/>
    <line x1='57' y1='44' x2='59' y2='34'/>
  </g>
  <circle cx='41' cy='32' r='6' fill='#fff2a8'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='32' r='6' fill='#fff2a8'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='32' r='2.5' fill='#2b1a4a'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='32' r='2.5' fill='#2b1a4a'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 64 Q50 70 56 64' stroke='#ffd9a8' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- left claw raised -->
  <g>
    <path d='M28 56 L14 40' stroke='#ff7b5e' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M14 40 Q4 32 8 24 Q14 18 20 26 Q24 30 18 38 Z' fill='#ff5c39' stroke='#ffa07a' stroke-width='2.5'/>
    <path d='M18 38 L8 30' stroke='#ffa07a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
  <!-- right claw raised -->
  <g>
    <path d='M72 56 L86 40' stroke='#ff7b5e' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M86 40 Q96 32 92 24 Q86 18 80 26 Q76 30 82 38 Z' fill='#ff5c39' stroke='#ffa07a' stroke-width='2.5'/>
    <path d='M82 38 L92 30' stroke='#ffa07a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
  <!-- little dance sparkles -->
  <g fill='#fff2a8'>
    <path d='M20 14 L22 20 L28 22 L22 24 L20 30 L18 24 L12 22 L18 20 Z'/>
    <path d='M80 14 L82 20 L88 22 L82 24 L80 30 L78 24 L72 22 L78 20 Z'/>
  </g>
</svg>
